descriptionChirho: God or Christ addressed or referred to as Lord, the supreme divine authority and sovereign ruler over all creation.
A human lord, master, or authority figure who exercises dominion over servants, slaves, or subordinates.
The owner or possessor of property, goods, or assets, emphasizing legal possession rather than authority over persons.
A respectful or courteous form of address to men of standing, without implying actual lordship or ownership.
